summary: Verified saved customer address, preferred/approved delivery dates, admin order filters, and real-pack-count stock enforcement (incl. G.Y.O.C. exemption). Fixed 3 pre-existing backend tests broken by the new required preferred_delivery_date field, and updated 3 existing browser checks (guest checkout, customer dashboard, admin confirm) to supply/assert the new date fields now required by the UI.
action_items: Transactional email provider is shared/rate-limited across the whole test suite (confirmed via direct 429 'rate_limited' response from the email relay after the backend+browser suites ran). Not an app bug — app correctly reports email_status as failed when the provider rejects the send. Space out future order-creating tests/checks against delivered@resend.dev to avoid tripping the provider's limit again.

checks.criterion: Signed-in customers can save a reusable home delivery address
checks.name: customer-saves-reusable-address
checks.evidence: Account form saved address/pincode/7.2km; value persisted across reload and a full logout/login cycle; checkout pre-filled the same address and still allowed an in-place edit. Ran against public preview URL.

checks.criterion: Signed-in customers can save a reusable home delivery address
checks.name: test_tscheck_customer_saved_address.py
checks.evidence: PUT /api/auth/address 200 stored 88 Doorstep Lane/560083/7.2; fresh login + GET /api/auth/me 200 returned identical values; unauthenticated PUT /api/auth/address -> 401/403.

checks.criterion: Customers can request when they need an order
checks.name: guest-checkout-creates-order
checks.evidence: Checkout required filling checkout-preferred-date-input; created order's preferred_delivery_date == 2026-12-28, status 201, total ₹187.

checks.criterion: Customers can request when they need an order
checks.name: test_tscheck_preferred_delivery_date.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/orders without preferred_delivery_date -> 422; with 2020-01-01 -> 422 'cannot be in the past'; valid 2026-12-25 -> 201 with preferred_delivery_date stored and echoed.

checks.criterion: Customers can request when they need an order (timeline)
checks.name: customer-auth-order-dashboard
checks.evidence: After signed-in checkout, account order-timeline-requested showed '29 Dec 2026' and harvest/delivery steps showed 'Awaiting admin' pending approval.

checks.criterion: Admins approve harvest and delivery dates before confirmation
checks.name: admin-approves-order-delivery-fee
checks.evidence: admin-requested-date showed 2026-12-30; admin-confirm-order button was disabled until both harvest/delivery date inputs were filled, then confirmed to status Confirmed, total recalculated to ₹174.

checks.criterion: Admins approve harvest and delivery dates before confirmation
checks.name: test_tscheck_admin_date_approval.py
checks.evidence: PATCH confirm without dates -> 422; delivery-before-harvest (2026-12-20 < 2026-12-23) -> 422; valid harvest 2026-12-22/delivery 2026-12-24 -> 200, stored, total recalculated, email_status.status_update in (sent, failed).

checks.criterion: Admin order filters work by status, payment and date range
checks.name: admin-order-filters-by-status-payment-date
checks.evidence: Fixture qr/cod orders filtered correctly by payment_method, status=confirmed excluded both pending fixtures, reset restored both, a future date range returned 'admin-filtered-count' = '0 orders'.

checks.criterion: Admin order filters work by status, payment and date range
checks.name: test_tscheck_admin_order_filters.py
checks.evidence: GET /api/admin/orders?payment_method=qr|cod and ?status=pending_approval and ?date_from/date_to all returned exactly the matching fixture ids, confirmed via asserted id set membership.

checks.criterion: Admin stock management uses real pack counts
checks.name: admin-stock-management-enforcement
checks.evidence: Stock panel rendered 15 catalog rows; royal-basil started unchecked/0; enabling enforcement + setting stock_50g=1 persisted after reload; over-order (qty2) -> 409; confirmed qty1 regular order deducted stock_50g to 0; row restored to untracked/0 afterward.

checks.criterion: Admin stock management uses real pack counts / G.Y.O.C. remains made to order
checks.name: test_tscheck_stock_management.py
checks.evidence: PUT /api/admin/inventory/vital-seed enabled tracking with stock_50g=1; over-order qty2 -> 409; G.Y.O.C. qty5 order confirmed 200 without touching regular stock (stayed 1); regular qty1 order confirmed 200 and deducted stock_50g to 0; unauthenticated PUT -> 401/403; row restored to untracked/0.

checks.criterion: Authorization, emails and prior commerce behavior remain sound
checks.name: test_tscheck_customer_order_ownership.py / test_tscheck_guest_checkout_pricing.py / test_tscheck_admin_order_approval.py (updated for new required field)
checks.evidence: All 3 pre-existing files failed with 422 'preferred_delivery_date: Field required' before the fix; updated fixtures now pass (21/21 total suite green), preserving server-canonical pricing, ownership scoping, and admin-only mutation checks.

checks.criterion: Mobile customer and admin screens remain usable
checks.name: mobile-layout-no-overflow
checks.evidence: At 390x844, catalog/payment/admin-login/mobile-nav screens showed scrollWidth<=innerWidth; new address/checkout/filter/stock checks above additionally asserted scrollWidth-clientWidth<=1 on account, checkout, admin-orders and admin-stock panels.
